audit.whatIsWrong: loading and report[8]/report[10] refer to Janna with 'his', per lintFindings MISGENDER.
audit.why: Janna is she/her; the owner (Nami) is addressed as 'you', so third-person pronouns refer to the enemy.
audit.corrected: Replace 'his' with 'her' in all three fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Howling Gale and Nami's own Q generically with no real cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Howling Gale (Q) is 14s flat and telegraphed by its charge-up; Monsoon (R) is 130/115/100s and heals through chip, which also covers the missingInteractions anti-heal-timing note.
audit.corrected: Cite Howling Gale's 14s cooldown and Monsoon's 130/115/100s with the Grievous Wounds timing note.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreement: full phases[0..3,5,6].side all say 'Skill' while content win[0..3,5,6] all say 'Nami'. Level 6 (row 4) already agrees at 'Skill' on both layers.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches content.win[] exactly, so content is the accurate side and full is stale/templated.
audit.corrected: Move phases[0,1,2,3,5,6].side to 'Nami' with why text grounded in the existing (accurate) content whys[]: E-buffed poke and the Level 2 Aqua Prison all-in beat Janna's disengage-only kit pre-6; Nami's offensive R+Q edges her out post-item.
